name: Binance Bitcoin (BTCB)
description: BTCB is the Bitcoin token on BNB Smart Chain, issued through Binance. Agents can read BTCB balances and transfer or approve the token on BNB Chain.

keyFunctions.description: Send BTCB to a recipient. Amount is in base units (18 decimals).
Set a spender allowance. Amount is in base units.
Spend an allowance: from, to, amount in base units.
BTCB balance of an address, in base units.
Allowance an owner gave a spender: owner, spender.
Total BTCB supply on BNB Chain, in base units.
Token decimals. Returns 18 on BNB Chain.

actions.name: check balance
actions.description: Read a BTCB balance on BNB Chain

actions.name: transfer
actions.how: transfer(address,uint256) on the BTCB contract, amount in 18-decimal base units

risks: BTCB is a bridged or pegged token. Its value depends on the custody and bridge behind it.
Only the BNB Chain address is listed. Other chains are not covered by this entry.
notes: The official BNB Chain blog states that 0x7130d2a12b9bcbfae4f2634d864a1ee1ce3ead9c is the official and unique BTCB address on BSC. A third-party page showed a different address (0xdff8f1da07a557ec14a7f9a0340c360f8ed26124). That address was not used. The contract has code on BSC and reports 18 decimals.
